description: This file implements various message output classes and functions for logging and message formatting, including console, syslog, file, JSON conversion, and UDP transmission within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Provides a method to convert message metadata and text into a formatted string.

classes.name: ConsoleOutput
classes.description: Handles outputting messages to the console (stdout).

classes.name: SyslogOutput
classes.description: Handles outputting messages to syslog or console on Windows.

classes.name: FileOutput
classes.description: Handles writing messages to a file.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Provides conversion of message metadata and text into a JSON data structure.

classes.name: UDPOutput::Channel
classes.description: Represents a UDP communication channel, managing data transmission.

methods.name: Text::Convert
methods.description: Converts message metadata and text into a string with a specific format.

methods.name: ConsoleOutput::Message
methods.description: Outputs a message to the console.

methods.name: SyslogOutput::Message
methods.description: Outputs a message to syslog or console on Windows.

methods.name: FileOutput::Message
methods.description: Writes a message to an open file.

methods.name: JSON::Convert
methods.description: Converts message metadata and text into a JSON data structure.

methods.name: UDPOutput::Channel::Output
methods.description: Prepares and triggers UDP data transmission.

methods.name: UDPOutput::Message
methods.description: Creates a text message and sends it over UDP.
